messages:
alex: Heads-up — we need to run a blue/green swap for edge-bridge this Thursday during the maintenance window (02:00-03:30 UTC). Target rollout: v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0. Can we confirm rollout steps and rollback criteria?

sarah: +1 for Thurs. Can we do a small canary first? 5% for 10m, then 25/50/100 if good.

mike: 5% canary sounds right. Also recommend prewarming KV caches and running synthetic traffic for 15m before canary. Last time cold caches spiked p95.

lena: I put the release notes in the release doc: https://internal/release/edge-bridge/v3.3.0 — main changes: connection multiplexing, router header tweak, and config flag `enable_stream_coalesce`. Addons: new LB affinity option.

ops-eng: FYI the new LB affinity option requires a short config rollout on the router; if we need to rollback, make sure we revert the affinity flags before traffic switch back or sticky sessions will mismatch.

alex: Good call. Plan proposal: 1) Prewarm: deploy v3.3.0 to green pool (no traffic) + prewarm cache 15m with synthetic traffic. 2) Canary 5% for 10m, metrics check. 3) Ramp 25% for 10m, 50% for 10m, 100% if stable. 4) Hold 30m for post-rollout checks. Rollback trigger: error rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency > 2.5x baseline OR consumer errors in router logs.

deploy-bot: @alex acknowledged. Scheduling blue/green swap for service=edge-bridge, from=pool-blue v3.2.1 -> pool-green v3.3.0, window=2023-11-09T02:00:00Z-2023-11-09T03:30:00Z, canarySteps=[5,25,50,100]. To begin, run `/deploy prewarm edge-bridge green --duration 15m`.

sarah: Quick Q — who will be on-watch for the first 30m after 100%? I can cover the first 30m. We should have someone on infra pager for 60m.

tom: I'll take infra pager for the first hour. I'll also watch p95 and tail router error logs. Logging snippet to watch: ```grep -i "upstream_error" /var/log/router/*.log | tail -n 100```

mike: Prewarm command: ```/deploy prewarm edge-bridge green --concurrency 120 --pattern warm-conn --duration 15m``` — that should exercise connection reuse. Also enable `collect-kv-stats` for prewarm build.

lena: Adding release-note blurb for customers: "Edge Bridge v3.3.0 — improved connection reuse and lower median latency. Default behavior unchanged; opt-in for affinity via config."

ops-eng: One more: if we hit partial degradation during 25% -> 50% ramp, plan is to pause ramp and run a targeted sweep: pin traffic back to blue for affected regions only (eu-west1). We need to ensure the router routing rule supports per-region partial pin. Ops-runbook snippet: ```curl -X POST https://router-admin/release/pin -d '{"service":"edge-bridge","region":"eu-west1","pin_to":"blue"}'```

alex: OK. We will run the prewarm at T-20m then start canary. I'll open an internal post in #incidents if we hit rollback. Any objections?

sarah: No objections. One ask: include the observability dashboards in the ops checklist: p95, p99, error-rate, connection-failures, backend-5xx.

tom: noted. I'll make a quick dashboard bookmark and share in this thread during rollout.

deploy-bot: /deploy prewarm started for service=edge-bridge pool=green run_id=pb-9876 started_at=1745552400 expected_end=1745553300

mike: Prewarm logs look healthy so far. KV miss rate dropping from 62% -> 12% after 10m.

deploy-bot: /deploy canary start service=edge-bridge percent=5 run_id=can-1001 started_at=1745553000

sarah: Monitoring: error-rate stable at 0.02%, p95 +8% vs baseline. No increase in upstream_errors. Proceeding to 25% after 10m if stable.

deploy-bot: /deploy canary update run_id=can-1001 percent=25 started_at=1745553600

ops-eng: Heads up — alert: eu-west1 p95 jumped 3.4x at 25% ramp, tied to connection resets to a single backend pool. Rolling back region eu-west1 to blue now.

alex: Pausing global ramp. Can we pin eu-west1 back to blue and keep other regions at 25%?

deploy-bot: /router-admin pin region=eu-west1 service=edge-bridge target=blue result=ok timestamp=1745553820


tom: After pin, eu-west1 p95 returned to within baseline. Other regions stable. We should investigate connection spread — looks like a backend upgrade left one host with old keepalive settings. I opened ticket INFRA-4512.

mike: OK to resume ramp for non-affected regions. Recommend adding a throttled step: 35% -> 50% just to watch tail latency.

alex: Agreed. Resume canary for global except eu-west1 at 35%. Keep eu-west1 pinned.

deploy-bot: /deploy canary update run_id=can-1001 percent=35 exclude_regions=["eu-west1"] started_at=1745554200

sarah: At 35% global (ex eu-west1) metrics fine. After 50% I'll request a 30m hold.

ops-eng: Note for postmortem: ensure we verify backend keepalive and connection settings during pre-deploy checklist. Also add a preflight check that calls /health across backend pool.

lena: I'll update release doc with rollback note and the INFRA-4512 link. Postmortem action item list: prewarm KV, preflight backend health, per-region pin runbook, dashboard bookmarks.

deploy-bot: /deploy complete run_id=can-1001 status=rolled-forward final_percent=100 started_at=1745553000 completed_at=1745556000 notes="eu-west1 had a temporary pin at 25% due to backend keepalive mismatch; resolved by INFRA-4512; full rollout completed to 100% with 30m hold"

alex: Thanks everyone. Closing the loop — v3.3.0 is live. Postmortem + action items in the release doc. :party_parrot:"
